title:
One method.
Many ways to use it.

elements.text: Use visual canvases and workshops to make decisions together.
Give AI assistants structured method knowledge and reusable tools.
Use open data and code to bring the method into your own workflows.

notes: APIOps Cycles / Osaango Ltd. Method content CC-BY-SA 4.0. Original artwork retained from the supplied Pariisi-Messuvihko.pptx. Feature coverage follows the user-supplied method features screenshot and apps/site/src/content/features.ts. Visual canvas workspaces export JSON; /data provides catalog, canvas manifest, method graph and prompt packs. The installed canonical apiops-cycles-method-data 4.2.1 package exports method-engine and method-cli. Its README documents npm create apiops@latest; CLI help supports start, resources and generate-canvases. AI context is an integration input, not a claim that a live MCP service or autonomous execution is included. Sources: apps/site/src/pages/features/ai-ready-method.astro, open-json-data.astro, DataContent.astro and node_modules/apiops-cycles-method-data/README.md.
